caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate candlestick holder rendered in grayscale pencil on a light beige background. The candlestick holder features intricate details with a botanical motif, including leaf shapes at the base and around the candle socket. The holder's base is broad and shaped like a cluster of overlapping leaves, with small rounded feet visible underneath. The central stem, which supports the candle socket, is decorated with curling vines and leaves. The candle socket itself is shaped like a flower, with petal-like projections extending outward. To the left, there is a curved handle that is also decorated with leaf and scrollwork patterns. The entire object is shaded to emphasize its three-dimensional form and surface texture. The artist's signature, "Helen Hobart," is located in the lower left area of the drawing. The overall composition centers the candlestick holder on a plain background with some faint spots and discoloration.
title: Candlestick
